text:
Maya: @here Friendly holiday thing: making a small Redwood 2026 desk calendar of employee pets. Who's in? :sparkles:
Maya: Rules: send one photo, filename like `name_owner.jpg`, plus a 1-line caption (<= 12 words). Submit by Friday 11:59pm PT.
Maya: We'll run an anonymous vote in #random next Monday. Ops chooses the cover from top 6. Winners get a printed calendar + $25 to a local pet shop.
Sam: LOL yes. Luna will be very offended if I don't enter. :cat_with_wry_smile:
Priya: Milo is such a drama queen, might get a full month just for side-eye.
Carlos: can we include 'honorable plant friends'? my pothos is my silent partner. :seedling:
Maya: let's limit to animals. Plants get honorable mention on the back page/bloopers.
Jen: can remote folks ship a print? I'm UK-based so shipping is messy.
Maya: if shipping is hard, DM me a 2MB+ hi-res image and we'll handle prints and delivery voucher.
CalendarBot: Submission recorded: Sam (luna_maya.jpg). Remaining slots: unlimited.
Sam: uploaded file. caption: "Luna: Certified snack evaluator." :cookie:
Arun: Bet my parrot will photobomb. submitting hopeful shot now.
Priya: uploaded milo_priya.jpg — caption: "Milo: I tolerate your traditions." :smirk:
Carlos: uploaded (blurry but sincere). caption: "Boris, headbutt specialist." :joy:
Jen: uploaded doggo + caption: "All I want for the holidays: snacks, naps, more snacks." :dog:
Maya: Reminder: name the file correctly or CalendarBot will reject it and you'll have to re-upload.
CalendarBot: Warning: file name "IMG_1234.jpg" rejected for Priya. Please rename to caption style.
Priya: oops renaming now, thanks bot.
Carlos: how are winners chosen? democratic poll? bragging rights?
Maya: anonymous poll for staff in #random: top 12 -> calendar months; top 6 -> ops chooses cover. We'll also have a small 'bloopers' spread for fun shots (no prize).
Sam: can we do categories? best holiday outfit, most dramatic stare, cutest nap?
Maya: Maybe. For simplicity we'll do single vote. If enough submissions we can add category flair stickers on the calendar.
CalendarBot: Reminder scheduled: 1767119856 -> 1767123256 (24h left).
Arun: idea: include a 1-line micro bio under each photo: pet age + weird habit. keep it short.
Maya: love that. keep it one line. e.g., "Luna, 3, will trade naps for chicken."
Carlos: who edits captions? mine is very honest: "Boris eats paper."
Maya: Ops editorial reserves the right to remove profanity or anything identifying. Otherwise we'll use your provided captions.
Jen: timeline check: votes Monday, print order Tuesday, arrive by early Jan?
Maya: yes that's the plan. Good Q for People Ops: can we print a few extra for the office kitchen?
Priya: maybe a digital version for folks who are remote?
Maya: yup we'll make a PDF and share. Physical prints for office + winners.
Sam: hype! sending extra candid shots for the bloopers page. :camera_flash:
Carlos: same, but warn you I have many blurry tail photos.
Maya: perfect. Thanks everyone — will post a final reminder on Thursday AM. :calendar: :paw_prints:
